report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300s window (policy-window-1), no failures were observed for checkout or any of its dependency calls in the evidence this Run obtained. Checkout's client-side gRPC calls to payment (Charge), cart (GetCart, EmptyCart), currency (Convert), product-catalog (GetProduct), and shipping (GetQuote, ShipOrder) all reported rpc_grpc_status_code=0 with no ERROR status in checkout's span-count series (044fbee8-35a3-4e7b-9a22-481c27cfa787-t2:450a55b1-17bf-467f-af7c-875a58a4e8fb, 044fbee8-35a3-4e7b-9a22-481c27cfa787-t1:b45f05a8-c968-40fa-badb-4de70e4a6b16). Sampled spans for checkout, payment, product-catalog, cart, and email carried error_by_visible_tags=false, grpc status 0 or HTTP 200, e.g. traces 0d1e30bb1d072a496fe68b779d417ccc, d08e12cadcf0ce590a35daeda487ca1b, 2f32f9f00af38d6a3e46c0497e4d50c6, 7c9ce91297fb737eb342a6e17efb2c31, a50964fb459accf2c1ca499860f66587 (044fbee8-35a3-4e7b-9a22-481c27cfa787-t3:000e6772-d65d-4330-b8a6-c55af6cba439, cadb191e-c0b6-4b06-b14a-dee0ef87f365-t2:9a6c66d9-026e-4f5e-a12e-9e0fab13944c, cadb191e-c0b6-4b06-b14a-dee0ef87f365-t3:171381d4-33c0-445c-b235-8a3587f66a41, fa63a1cd-5fbb-443a-af3c-4e653d1d7cea-t4:28e37eec-35a9-4381-85c8-d01dbdb9b98a, fa63a1cd-5fbb-443a-af3c-4e653d1d7cea-t5:32d8b56c-fad8-4a1d-ae4a-3ff22f3e0838). Observed latencies in-window were modest (checkout server p95 167.5 ms; checkout client p95 per method 4.75-61.25 ms; checkout PlaceOrder sampled spans 29-105 ms). However, the reported 'elevated errors' could not be confirmed or refuted for checkout itself because no ERROR-status series and no baseline period exist in the delivered evidence; latency elevation is not assessable without a comparable baseline. Several views were no_data or flagged incomplete, so this is not a complete call-chain or error-free certification.

The hypothesis that checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) returned failing gRPC/HTTP responses within this 300s window is not supported by the evidence obtained: every visible status code on those services' spans and client calls is 0 or HTTP 200, and no ERROR-status series appears for them.
